author: Pontoppidan, 1763
summary: 해마다 수십 마리가 찾아오는 드문 겨울철새로 동해 연안에서 관찰되며, 바닷가 섬의 암초와 암벽에서 산다. 바다 위를 헤엄치고 잠수하며 물고기, 게와 새우 같은 갑각류, 연체동물, 벼과 식물의 열매를 먹는다. 수백에서 수만 마리가 큰 무리를 이루어 함께 번식하며, 둥지를 짓지 않고 암벽이나 암초 위에 바로 알을 낳는다. 세계적으로는 동아시아, 유럽, 북아메리카에 분포한다.

points.en: white face, cheeks and neck sides (non-breeding)

art.subject: Common Murre (Uria aalge), adult in winter plumage, as seen off the Korean east coast from December to February: crown, hindneck and upperparts dark sooty brown-black; cheeks, throat and foreneck white, with a thin dark line curving back from the eye across the white cheek; breast and belly white; narrow white tips to the secondaries show as a thin white line on the closed wing. Bill black, long, slender and sharply pointed; dark eye; legs and feet dark grey.
art.pose: swimming on the sea surface, about to dive
art.scene: Korean East Sea off the east coast in winter, grey choppy water with a distant rocky island; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (spring), side view swimming: dark chocolate-brown head and neck, slightly browner on the foreneck, dark brown-black back, white breast meeting the dark neck in a rounded line, long straight pointed black bill
adult non-breeding (winter), side view swimming: white face, cheeks, throat and neck sides with a thin dark line behind the eye, dark crown and hindneck, same long black bill
adult in flight, seen from below: white breast, belly and underwing, narrow white tips to the secondaries forming a white trailing edge, short tail
art.build: Large, slender-necked auk, smaller than a Mallard, with a long, pointed head profile. Bill black, straight, slender and sharply pointed, about as long as the head. Swims low with the bill held level and dives often; on rock stands upright, resting on its tarsi. Tail short and rounded. Wings short and narrow; flight fast and low over the sea with whirring wingbeats, showing a whitish underwing and a thin white trailing edge to the inner wing.
avoid: Do not paint the short, deep bill with a white line along the gape of Thick-billed Murre (Uria lomvia).
Do not paint the face all dark on the winter bird; the cheeks and throat are white with a thin dark line behind the eye.
Do not paint a white wing patch (Cepphus guillemots) or orange feet.
Do not paint a stubby bill or a colourful puffin-like bill.
